faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JJB Kanniyakumari recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the JJB Kanniyakumari recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 for Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and 1 for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post is passing the VIII Standard or its equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the JJB Kanniyakumari recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post is Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Office Assistant post is Rs. 13,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection criteria for the JJB Kanniyakumari recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website www.kanniyakumarinic.in.
